description:

1. Flat-Panel Television Screen (LED/OLED glass display matrix & bezel): Fractured internal display panel and cracked screen matrix — panel cannot be repaired [Red ROI box: 19% area] — Damage Rate: 87% · Est. 950 TND (replacement required).
2. Wooden Wardrobe / Cabinet (Solid oak wood & lacquered veneer): Surface veneer gouge on door panel + bent hinge alignment [Red ROI box: 29% area] — Damage Rate: 53% · Est. 160 TND (repairable).
3. Framed Picture / Wall Art (Protective glazing glass & wooden frame moulding): Shattered protective front glass pane & frame corner scuff (framer re-glazing) [Red ROI box: 29% area] — Damage Rate: 53% · Est. 45 TND (repairable).
Total assessed repair/replacement value: 1155 TND.
